added.summary: New props label (the quest's kind over its name, Main quest), tracked, canTrack and canLocate. With canTrack a primary Track button reports track, and once tracked a quiet Stop tracking button reports track; with canLocate Show on map reports locate. The actions stay at the frame's foot while the body scrolls and fades above them. The scenery is a banner under the title, shaded into the frame's glass; objectives hang from their stage on a rail with the stage in play lit gold; rewards are cut chips with an octagon socket, a reward with a detail lit gold. New parts RpgQuestDetail.actions and RpgQuestDetail.fade, and a long fixture.

Groups are gold small capitals behind a short gold rule, a finished group quiet; the tracked quest's diamond is lit gold, a finished quest's filled; the selected row is washed gold from its leading edge with a chevron toward the detail; a fresh update carries a New tag (new part RpgQuestLog.fresh). An overflow fixture.

HUD type over the scene with no plate: the quest in gold small capitals, a gold diamond per objective (filled once done, its words struck) and a thin leaning bar in a dark well, cut into cells when an objective's new steps field is above 1. On a phone only the objective in play shows.

Day tiles with two corners cut: a header strip, the reward large, its amount and a foot with its state. Today is lit gold with a Claim foot, a taken day carries a check stamp over its dimmed art, a missed day is hatched, a milestone is violet with a ribbon (string general.rewards.milestone). Three across on a phone, a last day alone taking the whole row.

breaking.change: Each quest is a cut card: its icon in an octagon socket, its name over a leaning bar with its count beside it, its prize in a dark box at the end; a done quest is lit gold with a gold Claim, a claimed one dims behind a Claimed stamp (new part DailyQuests.claimed). On a narrow list the socket goes and the prize and Claim take a line of their own. DailyQuests.name no longer wears the headline role and the DailyQuests.headline part is gone.
breaking.fix: A style that dressed DailyQuests.headline dresses DailyQuests.name. Set the --quest-* tokens for the family's look.

breaking.change: The overall count is a large figure over a leaning gold bar under the band, not in it. Each achievement is a cut card: a hexagon medal in its tier's colour, its name and description, its state or progress bar with the count, the tier on a chip, and at the end the share of players large (its accessible name says of players) and a gold Claim or a Claimed stamp (new part Achievements.claimed). A hidden one is hatched. On a narrow list the rarity takes a line under the words and Claim a line of its own. The parts Achievements.well, Achievements.headline and Achievements.label on the summary, tier and rarity are gone: Achievements.medal, .name, .summary, .tier and .rarity are named alone.
breaking.fix: A style that dressed Achievements.well, Achievements.headline or Achievements.label dresses Achievements.medal, Achievements.name, or Achievements.tier and Achievements.state. Set the --quest-* tokens for the family's look.
